why: The video is heavy on dense, clinical information and text-heavy news clippings which can be visually fatiguing. The pacing is slightly slow for a short-form format, and the topic, while interesting, lacks a strong emotional or personal hook to sustain viewer retention for over a minute.

Overlaying text-based news snippets to add credibility to claims.
